data.sub: Patidar ne 8 chauke aur 13 chhakke maar 135 run banaye.

chat.say: Bhai ball dhoondh ke thak gaye, naya lao!
Ruko abhi stadium paar bhejni baaki hai!

data.asar: Gali cricket mein sab Patidar banne ka try karenge.
data.caption:
Rajat Patidar ka SMAT mein bhayankar toofan! Bowlers ke hosh ud gaye. 💥🏏

- Rajat Patidar ne match mein thoke 135 run
- Apni paari mein lagaye 13 aakash-chumbi chhakke
- Sath mein 8 chauke bhi jadd diye
- T20 career ki sabse dhasu innings kheli

Bowlers ab ball nahi, chupne ki jagah dhoondh rahe hain. 😂

Apne us dost ko tag karo jo har ball par chhakka maarne ke chakkar mein catch out hota hai!
